novel_features.name: Typed v2-aligned mirror into local SQLite
novel_features.description: Sync a domain's data into typed SQLite tables that match schema/model.yaml exactly — keywords, keyword_ranks, domain_history, etc. AccuRanker's mandatory fields= parameter is auto-filled per resource. Resumable across runs.

novel_features.name: NDJSON dump with auto-chunked window
novel_features.description: Stream historical rank or domain-history data over any window. The CLI walks 100-day slices internally and dedups, emitting one record per line.

novel_features.name: Machine-readable schema for v2 mirror
novel_features.description: Print the canonical data shape — every resource, field, filter dimension, comparator legality, and sync hint — as JSON or Postgres DDL.

novel_features.name: Discoverable filter dimensions
novel_features.description: List all 100+ filter dimensions AccuRanker accepts in dynamic filter expressions, with type class and accepted comparators.

novel_features.name: SERP-feature gain/loss delta
novel_features.description: Partition a domain's keywords into gained / lost / held for any SERP feature (AI Overview, featured snippet, local pack, etc.) over a date window.

novel_features.name: Cannibalization detection
novel_features.description: Flag keywords where multiple URLs from the same domain rank simultaneously, or where the highest-ranking page flips across the window.

novel_features.name: Decay opportunity finder
novel_features.description: Find keywords whose rank is getting worse while their search volume is climbing — the classic 'losing ground on rising demand' set.

novel_features.name: Keyword spec diff before apply
novel_features.description: Compare a local CSV/NDJSON keyword spec against AccuRanker's current keyword list. Emits adds/removes/updates without writing.

novel_features.name: Push local mirror to remote Postgres
novel_features.description: Upsert every table from the local SQLite mirror into a remote Postgres schema using DDL derived from schema/model.yaml. The bridge to a downstream analytics layer.
